Marked 18.1.1 from the official npm marked package. Used locally to render imported Bear Markdown. License: marked-LICENSE. Output is sanitized before insertion.

fflate 0.8.3 from the official npm fflate package. Used locally to unpack dropped Bear ZIP packages. License: fflate-LICENSE. No runtime network requests.

The drawing window loads the prebuilt Excalidraw 0.17.6 browser distribution with React and React DOM 18.2.0. Production scripts, the English editor's assets and licenses are in excalidraw/. The app can load these files locally.
